properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The wallet's core signing curve — vendored libsecp256k1 plus the app shim. ECDSA secp256k1 is Shor-vulnerable; the curve is fixed by Bitcoin/Ethereum consensus, so this is observable here but replaceable only by the chains, not unilaterally by the app. Deadline-class risk. Changeable portion: keeping the vendored library current.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Alchemy JWT auth service: Cloudflare Worker (Workers/alchemy-jwt) signs JWTs with RS256; iOS/macOS app (AlchemyJWTProvider.swift) verifies them. RSA signature — Shor-vulnerable, deadline-class risk; migrate to ML-DSA-65 (or a hybrid PQC JWT) coordinated across worker and app. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The alchemy-jwt service's RSA keypair — used for SIGNING (RS256 JWTs), not encryption, so the migration is ML-DSA-65, not ML-KEM-768. Worker verifies with WebCrypto; keypair generated and validated by the ops scripts before upload. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-only golden vector: the nonce literal exists to make AES-GCM test output deterministic. Not a production IV source; recorded with that limitation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 account keys and signatures for Ed25519-based chains in the wallet proxy. Curve25519 signature curve — quantum-unsafe under Shor; ML-DSA migration is constrained by each chain's protocol (observable here, replaceable only per-chain), though any app-internal Ed25519 use is changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Positive posture control in the alchemy-jwt key-upload/validation pipeline: constant-time digest and key comparisons. Kept as the good-practice counterpart to the non-constant-time comparisons recorded elsewhere.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (pre-NIST-padding SHA-3 variant) is fixed by the Ethereum protocol for addresses, EIP-712 and transaction signing — observable here, replaceable only by chain consensus. The keystore MAC use in WalletCoreProxyStoredKey is app-controlled.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 uses: non-security cache keys, protocol-mandated checksums (BIP32/BIP39), JWT thumbprints, and key-fingerprint pinning. PQ-safe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: BLAKE3 hash ships in the alchemy-jwt worker bundle. PQ-safe hash, no Shor exposure. Changeable here (swap dependency), though no replacement needed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed fingerprint that pins the alchemy-jwt request-proof shared secret (key itself injected as a deployment secret, digest committed for verification). Changeable here.
